title: 第984章 争夺第983章 变故
slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
盆地远端的风沙之中，一道灰色身影缓缓显现。
此人同样狼狈至极，衣衫撕裂，周身布满深浅不一的血痕，干涸的血迹牢牢黏在肌肤之上。
那人手中紧握着一柄暗金色断剑，一双眼眸阴鸷冷冽，一步步踏破漫天风沙缓步走出。
正是林天。
他方才在葬剑峡不眠不休挖掘材料，足足熬了三天三夜，早已疲惫得如同筋疲力竭的死狗，浑身筋骨处处发酸。
可当察觉到这片盆地升起的异象之时，所有疲惫瞬间被心底的欲望压下。
林天的视线径直越过拦在前方的叶辰，牢牢锁定巨石顶端那柄流光熠熠的古剑。
古剑之上飘荡的那一缕【万法本源】气息落入感知。
他与生俱来的寻宝直觉疯狂轰鸣，发出前所未有的强烈警报。
“绝世神兵！这一定是超脱此方天地界限的无上神兵！”
林天伸出舌头，舔了舔起皮干裂的嘴唇，眼底翻腾的贪婪浓烈得几乎要化作实质流淌而出。
他缓缓转动脖颈，目光落在对面形同乞丐一般的叶辰身上，面色冰冷，薄唇轻启，冷冷吐出四个字。
“滚开，或者死。”
林天声音冷硬，不带半分回旋余地，凛冽的杀意伴随着漫天风沙朝着叶辰压迫而去。
叶辰听闻此言，先是一怔，随即怒极反笑，低沉的笑声带着几分桀骜。
他昔日乃是中州万众瞩目的第一天才，纵使眼下虎落平阳，深陷天渊神境受尽磨难，刻在骨血之中的傲气也从未磨灭半分。
更何况眼前乃是传闻中的仙帝至宝，机缘造化摆在眼前，他又如何甘心拱手相让？
“哪里冒出来不长眼的疯狗？”
叶辰眉宇间戾气翻涌，双手飞快变幻法印，滚滚灼热灵气自四肢百骸汇聚掌心。
一团跳动不息的赤红火焰缓缓凝聚，热浪扭曲了周遭的空气。

“这件宝物是我率先发现，识相的立刻退走，不然小爷便将你焚烧至神魂俱灭！”
“就凭你？”
林天唇角勾起一抹讥讽的冷笑，手中那柄熔炼过太乙精金的断剑轻轻震颤，发出细碎的嗡鸣。
纵使此刻身处天渊神境，修为遭到天地规则压制，连日挖矿留下的伤势仍在撕扯肉身。
可在前世剑帝的眼光之下，叶辰灵力运转虚浮不稳，周身招式破绽百出，根本不足为惧。
叶辰心中清楚，眼前之人实力强横，绝非易与之辈，不敢再有保留，当即在识海急促呼唤外援。
“前辈，借我一点力量！”
“辰儿莫慌，我这便助你！”
药尊者浑厚的声音自古戒之中响起，一缕精纯磅礴的残魂力量瞬间倾泻而出，顺着经脉涌入叶辰四肢百骸。
澎湃力量冲刷之下，叶辰的修为气息节节攀升，转瞬暴涨至六重天巅峰。
“炎阳爆！”
叶辰厉声大喝，双臂奋力向前猛推。
一颗宛若小型陨星般庞大的火球腾空而起，赤红烈焰熊熊燃烧。
炙烈高温烘得空气不断扭曲，裹挟呼啸风声，径直朝着林天狠狠轰击而去。
content_en:
In the windy sand at the far end of the basin, a gray figure slowly appeared.
This man was also extremely embarrassed, his clothes were torn, and his whole body was covered with bloodstains of varying depths. The dried bloodstains stuck firmly to his skin.
The man held a dark golden broken sword tightly in his hand, his eyes were dark and cold, and he walked slowly out through the wind and sand in the sky step by step.
It was Lin Tian.
He had just been digging for materials in the Burial Sword Gorge without sleep for three days and three nights. He was already as tired as an exhausted dead dog, and his muscles and bones were aching everywhere.
But when he noticed the strange phenomenon rising in this basin, all the fatigue was instantly suppressed by the desire in his heart.
Lin Tian's gaze went straight past Ye Chen, who was blocking the front, and firmly locked on the shining ancient sword on the top of the boulder.
The breath of [The Origin of All Laws] floating on the ancient sword fell into perception.
His innate treasure-hunting intuition roared wildly, sounding an unprecedentedly strong alarm.
"A peerless divine weapon! This must be a supreme divine weapon that transcends the boundaries of this world!"
Lin Tian stuck out his tongue and licked his chapped lips. The greed in his eyes was so strong that it almost turned into substance and flowed out.
He slowly turned his neck, and his eyes fell on Ye Chen, who looked like a beggar opposite. His face was cold, his thin lips lightly opened, and he uttered four words coldly.
"Get away or die."
Lin Tian's voice was cold and hard, without any room for maneuver, and his murderous intent was compressed towards Ye Chen along with the wind and sand in the sky.
When Ye Chen heard this, he was startled for a moment, and then he laughed angrily. The low laughter was a bit unruly.
He used to be the number one genius in Zhongzhou that attracted much attention. Even though he is now trapped in the Tianyuan Divine Realm and suffering all kinds of hardships, the pride engraved in his bones and blood has never been eradicated.
What's more, the legendary treasure of the Immortal Emperor is in front of him. Opportunities are in front of him, how can he be willing to give it up?
"Where did a mad dog without eyes come from?"
Ye Chen's brows surged with anger, his hands quickly transformed into magic seals, and the hot spiritual energy gathered in his palms from his limbs.
A group of beating red flames slowly condensed, and the heat wave distorted the surrounding air.
"I was the first to discover this treasure. If you are wise, retreat immediately, otherwise I will burn you until your soul is completely destroyed!"
"Just you?"
A sarcastic sneer appeared on Lin Tian's lips, and the broken sword smelted with Taiyi fine gold in his hand trembled slightly and made a fine hum.
Even though he was currently in the Tianyuan Divine Realm, his cultivation was suppressed by the rules of heaven and earth, and the injuries from days of mining were still tearing at his body.
But under the eyes of the Sword Emperor in his previous life, Ye Chen's spiritual power was unstable and unstable, and his moves were full of flaws, so there was nothing to be afraid of.
Ye Chen knew in his heart that the person in front of him was powerful and not easy to deal with. He did not dare to hold back any more and immediately called for foreign aid from the sea of ​​consciousness.
"Senior, lend me a little strength!"
"Chen'er, don't panic, I'll help you right now!"
Master Yao's rich voice sounded from the ancient ring, and a ray of pure and majestic residual soul power poured out instantly, pouring into Ye Chen's limbs and bones along his meridians.
Under the surging force, Ye Chen's cultivation aura steadily increased, reaching the peak of the sixth heaven in an instant.
"Fire Yang Explosion!"
Ye Chen shouted loudly and pushed forward with both arms.
A huge fireball, like a small meteorite, rose into the sky, burning with red flames.
The scorching heat caused the air to twist continuously, carrying the whistling wind, and directly bombarded Lin Tian.
